Name: Benny Bark
Desc: A loyal little diner who treats every burger like a tail-wagging treasure.

Name: Coolcat Clyde
Desc: Too cool to hurry and always orders with a perfectly timed purr.

Name: Honey Hug Bear
Desc: Sweet as honey and twice as cuddly when the fries arrive.

Name: Bunbun Bella
Desc: Bounces in hungry and leaves with crumbs on both cheeks.

Name: Kitty Cupcake
Desc: Tiny paws big appetite and absolutely no shame about extra cheese.

Name: Red Rat Courier
Desc: The fastest red-tailed courier in town unless someone drops a fry.

Name: Boss Hogsworth
Desc: Runs the lunch rush like a boardroom and demands premium pickles.

Name: Brewster Beaver
Desc: Can spot a strong brew faster than a falling timber.

Name: Mocha Moo Rebel
Desc: Breaks cafe rules drinks bold roasts and never says moo softly.

Name: Hazel Squirrel
Desc: Carries emergency acorns and judges every latte by its foam.

Name: Tobi Tanuki
Desc: A cheerful trickster who somehow pays with leaves and perfect change.

Name: Willow Weasel
Desc: Slips into every coffee break and somehow leaves with the fanciest pastry.

Name: Greenwing Bird Courier
Desc: Delivers coffee at wing speed while keeping every feather spotless.

Name: Baron Bull
Desc: A polished cafe boss who considers foam art serious business.

Name: Chief Eagle
Desc: Keeps the cafe orderly with eagle eyes and a badge-shaped cookie.

Name: Kitsune Ojou
Desc: A graceful kitsune guest who orders sushi with theatrical elegance.

Name: Elephant Senpai
Desc: Studies the menu diligently and never wrinkles the school uniform.

Name: Aoi Yagi
Desc: This blue goat loves matcha and practices cheerful table manners.

Name: Tora-kun
Desc: A brave little tora who challenges every sushi roll to a duel.

Name: Ookami Oyabun
Desc: The wolf oyabun speaks softly and controls the sushi counter with one stare.

Name: Shiba Yokozuna
Desc: A shiba yokozuna who treats every sushi platter like a championship bout.
